scope.method: Parsed each activity-page mxCell graph, including start/end groups, vertices, edges, decisions, branch labels, and reachability. Disconnected overlay labels used to caption blank diamonds were treated as annotations rather than executable nodes.

summary.overall_assessment: The activity graphs are compact and largely connected. The main corrections are confined to UC3's pause/disconnect paths and a few documented outcomes omitted or contradicted by the diagrams.

structural_checks.result: Connected from initial node to final node; all branch outcomes converge on location confirmation or an intentional retry loop.
Connected; language and duration selection correctly loop to retrieval.
Main flow reaches a final node, but the audio-focus no path terminates at a non-final action and the device-disconnect branch also loops back to playback.
Connected; no invalid edge references or accidental loops found.
Connected; permission, cooldown, foreground, selection, and invalid-location outcomes all resolve to the final node.
Connected; invalid upload and missing-data retries return to the form as documented.
Connected; reporting-period and export-retry loops are intentional.

findings.title: Audio-focus refusal ends at a non-final action
findings.evidence: The 'Audio focus restored?' decision has a No edge to 'Remain paused' (cell fixNo-remainsPaused), which has no outgoing edge and is not a final node.
findings.requirements_comparison: UC-03 E2 says the system pauses and stores position; playback may continue only when focus is restored.
findings.recommendation: Connect 'Remain paused' to the UC final node. Keep the Yes branch as the only resume route.

findings.title: Output-device disconnect can immediately re-enter playback
findings.evidence: E3 'Output device disconnected' points both to 'Pause and save position' and directly back to the playback-event decision (cell o0_6KubHvzofkxdgklQR-15).
findings.requirements_comparison: UC-03 E3 requires automatic pause and stored position to prevent unintended speaker playback; it does not authorize automatic continuation after disconnect.
findings.recommendation: Remove the direct E3-to-playback loop. End after the paused state, or add an explicit later user-driven reconnection/resume event only if the requirements are expanded.

findings.title: No nearby-result path omits expansion of the search radius
findings.evidence: E2 'No attractions found nearby' offers only 'Choose another method' back to the method-selection decision.
findings.requirements_comparison: UC-01 E2 explicitly allows the Tourist to expand the current search radius before or instead of choosing A2/A3/A4.
findings.recommendation: Add a compact 'Expand radius' route from E2 back to 'Search locations within configured radius', or state that radius expansion is out of scope in the written UC.

findings.title: Delete-content cancellation is not represented
findings.evidence: The A2 node combines selection, confirmation, deletion, and status update, then ends; it contains no cancellation outcome.
findings.requirements_comparison: UC-04 A2 states that if the Tourist cancels deletion, nothing changes.
findings.recommendation: Add one compact cancel-to-final edge/outcome, or revise the A2 wording to remove the cancellation behavior.

findings.title: No-data branch proceeds to display feedback records
findings.evidence: The E1 'No data ... display Empty State instead of charts or records' node flows directly to 'Open feedback list: display recent feedback'.
findings.requirements_comparison: UC-07 E1 specifies an Empty State instead of charts or records when no data matches the selected reporting period or filter.
findings.recommendation: Either terminate after the Empty State, or clarify in the requirements that E1 applies only to analytics while feedback records remain independently available.

non_findings: Blank-diamond captions appear as disconnected annotation cells in several pages; their associated diamonds carry the actual edges, so these are not graph dead ends.
No malformed source or target references were found among logical activity edges.
Documented alternatives and exceptions were not required to receive a decision diamond when their compact action/outcome representation preserved the stated behavior.
